blocks.text: Network security is used to protect computer networks. It keeps data safe from unauthorized access. Security helps prevent data loss and damage. Many users connect to networks daily. Without security, networks become unsafe. Network security uses different tools and rules. It is important for homes and organizations. Network security protects personal and important information. It stops hackers from entering the network. Security keeps data private and safe. It also protects devices from malware. Secure networks work smoothly without interruptions. Every network needs basic security measures.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Discuss how security protects sensitive data like CT scans of patients in a hospital.

A firewall is a security device or software. It controls incoming and outgoing network traffic. Firewalls block harmful or unwanted data (as shown in Figure 1.17). They act as a barrier between safe and unsafe networks. Firewalls protect computers from attacks. They are used in homes and offices.

blocks.alt: A fire on the left sends red arrows that stop at a brick wall carrying a blue shield with a green tick; green arrows go on from the wall to a computer on the right.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.17: Firewall Protection (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 1.17).

blocks.text: Encryption changes data into a secret form. Only authorized users can read encrypted data. It protects data during transfer. Encryption is used in emails and online banking. Strong encryption improves data security. It prevents data theft.

Access control decides who can use the network. It allows only authorized users to enter. Usernames and passwords are common access controls. Permissions limit what users can do. Access control protects important resources. It helps manage network usage.

There are many threats to network security. Viruses and malware damage systems. Hackers try to steal data. Phishing tricks users to share information. Denial of Service attacks stop network services. Security tools help reduce these threats.
